violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AT 120-136F IN THE ONE-DOOR HOT-BOX COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED OF THE CHICKEN BY THE END OF THE INSPECTION. EHS DISCUSSED HOT HOLDING REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE HOT HOLDING FOODS ARE ALWAYS KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COLESLAW AT 54F, COOKED BEETS AT 51F, PASTA SALAD AT 50F, CHEESE AT 48F, SHREDDED CABBAGE AT 49F, AND SALAD MIX AT 47-51F IN THE TWO DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OR MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING THE INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE REINSTALL THE PREP TOP LID AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN THAWING ON THE COUNTER-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER THAWING METHODS WITH THE PIC AND CHICKEN WAS MOVED INTO THE WALK-IN COOLER. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED CASES OF BEVERAGES STORED IN THE BACK HALLWAY ON THE FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ELEVATE THESE BEVERAGES AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and is in poor repair: THE PREP-TOP PORTION OF THE TWO-DOOR PREP TOP WAS OBSERVED NOT REINSTALLED. FOODS IN THE PREP-TOP PORTION OF THE COOLER WERE NOT COLD HOLDING PROPERLY.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. TCS FOODS THAT WERE NOT COLD HOLDING WERE DISCARDED OR MOVED DURING INSPECTION FROM PREP TOP PORTION OF THE COOLER. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS ARE NOT KEPT HERE UNTIL THE PREP TOP LID IS INSTALLED. MR POLLO PERUVIAN CHARCOAL CHICKEN (Inspection Date: 06/22/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. OBSERVED THE THREE-VAT SINK SANITIZER COMPARTMENT NOT PROPERLY AIR-GAPPED AND WASH/RINSE COMPARTMENTS WITHOUT AN AIR BREAK AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PLEASE ENSURE THE THREE-VAT SINK IS PROPERLY AIR GAPPED/AIR BREAKED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS/HEALTH DEPARTMENT.
